name: Copperpot Solar Charger Mini
description: The Copperpot Solar Charger Mini. A dependable power pick with a clean, no-nonsense design and the everyday features you actually use.

specs.inTheBox: Solar Charger, Travel pouch, Quick-start guide, Regional plug heads, Warranty card

reviews.author: Gaurav R.
reviews.title: Exactly what I wanted
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Copperpot seem to have got this one right. Would buy the same one again.

reviews.author: Kavya P.
reviews.title: Would buy again
reviews.body: Been using this daily for about three months now. Setup took under ten minutes with no surprises. Matches the listing description exactly. Holding up well so far.

reviews.author: Tanvi S.
reviews.title: Better than expected
reviews.body: Bought this after returning two other brands. Setup took under ten minutes with no surprises. Packaging was tidy and nothing was missing. Would buy the same one again.
